name: telar
description: Project-centric agentic dev tool on the Claude Agent SDK — self-verifying looms where a human always accepts.
author: Facundo Barbera <facundo.barbera@gmail.com>

scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/engine-client typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/env typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/engine typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run typecheck:core-tests
scripts.test: bun run test:core && bun run test:engine-client && bun run test:env && bun run test:engine && bun run test:web && bun run test:desktop
